task.title: Discovering OPC UA server points
task.shortdesc: Server point discovery interrogates the connected OPC UA server to discover the OPC UA objects.

taskbody.prereq: You are working in running on a PC or laptop computer.

step.cmd: In the Nav Tree, expand ConfigDriversOpcUaNetworkOpcUaDevice.
To open the Opc Ua Client Point Manager, do one of the following:

choices.choice: Right-click the Points node and click ViewsOpc Ua Client Point Manager and click Opc Ua Client Point Manager.

step.stepresult: The Opc Ua Client Point Manager opens.

step.cmd: To configure Discovery Preferences before discovering points, right-click Points, click Views Property Sheet and expand Discovery Preferences.

info.note: Be sure to configure Discovery Preferences properties before attempting to discover points. It is possible to unintentionally filter out points or data. Refer to the “opcUaClient-OpcUaClientPointDeviceExt” topic for details on these properties.

step.stepresult:
The Property Sheet opens.
The properties control when the discovery prompt appears and which points a discovery job leaves out of the resulting Discovered table.

step.cmd: To start the discovery job, double-click Points in the Nav tree and click Discover.
step.stepresult: The discovery job communicates with the OPC UA server to discover the server’s object structure.

step.cmd: To browse the discovered objects, expand the items in the Discovered pane.

info.note: Starting in and , before adding discovered points to the station database, you must configure the following two properties in the Device Point Extension: Subscription Batch Delay and Max Monitored Items Per Subscription. Refer to the "opcUaClient-OpcUaClientPointDeviceExt" topic for details on these properties.

step.cmd: To add points to the station database, select the points to add and click Add or double-click on the selected object(s).
If the point is writable, change the point Type to a writable type and click OK.
step.stepresult:
The driver adds the point(s) to a subscribed state and updates them with real-time values.
If a point has engineering units, precision, and/or range information, the driver attempts to configure the point’s facets to match. This may not always be possible.
